Owner role: product-manager. Trigger: owner directive 2026-11-17 (what we do not know is a core feedback loop so the solution space expands).

Problem: loops that only improve what they know shrink the solution space. Needed: a tenant-agnostic registry of gaps, miners, red-team/inversion/pre-mortem passes, and a frontier that turns gaps into new questions and candidates.

Done check: `node --test core/ignorance/ignorance.test.js` passes; module README lists requirements IGN-1..6 with honest status.
Closing probe: the first tenant (Practical Solutions) shows known unknowns and red-team findings on its entries and /method, produced by this module.
